mock_data.title: Stress at Work
mock_data.passage:
Statistics show that more and more of us are suffering from stress and that much of this is caused by our jobs. It appears that many of us are working too hard and this is taking a toll on our health.

There is, experts tell us, simply too much pressure put on many employees these days. In many jobs, in sales or production departments, for example, unrealistic targets are set for the workforce. People are, in fact, trying to do the impossible and making themselves ill by doing so.

In many countries, more and more people are working longer hours. Some workers have to do this to cope with their workload, while others think that staying late will impress the boss so much that he will promote them. This extended presence in the workplace is known as presenteeism.

Such overwork often results in extreme fatigue, or even total exhaustion, with many people also suffering from insomnia. When the workers get home, instead of resting or enjoying a leisure pursuit, they simply cannot switch off. Their minds are still full of work worries.

Most people used to be able to leave behind the tension and anxiety of the workplace when they went on holiday. Unfortunately, modern communication systems, such as mobile phones and email, have made this a thing of the past. We find it almost impossible to leave our work behind.

Neither the body nor the mind can go on doing too much indefinitely. Workers reach a point beyond which they cannot cope, and have to take time off. Some may experience burn-out and some may become mentally ill. Meanwhile, a study by some American universities has shown that stress can weaken the immune system.

The fact that stress at work leads to illness is supported by findings by the British Health and Safety Executive. These indicate that 60 per cent of absence from work is a result of stress. It is time for us all to take stress seriously and to reconsider the ethos of modern working conditions. Working hard is important but everyone must realize that even productivity is less important than our health.
mock_data.passageB1:
Many people today are feeling stressed. Studies show that a lot of this stress comes from their jobs. It seems that many people are working too hard, and this is bad for their health.

Experts say that there is too much pressure on workers. For example, in some jobs, like sales, workers have to reach unrealistic goals. People are trying to do things that are too difficult, and this makes them sick.

In many countries, people are working longer hours. Some workers need to do this to finish their work. Others think that if they stay late, their boss will be impressed and give them a better job. This is called 'presenteeism' - being at work for a long time.

Working too much can make people very tired. Some people cannot sleep well (insomnia). When they go home, they cannot relax. They keep thinking about work problems.

In the past, people could forget about work when they went on holiday. But now, with mobile phones and email, it is difficult to leave work behind. It is hard to stop thinking about it.

Our bodies and minds cannot work too hard forever. People reach a point where they cannot cope. They need to take time off work. Some people get burn-out, and some become mentally ill. A study showed that stress can make our bodies weaker and more likely to get sick.

The British Health and Safety Executive says that 60% of people who are absent from work are away because of stress. We need to take stress seriously and think about how we work. Working hard is important, but our health is more important than being productive.
mock_data.passageB2:
Increasingly, statistics show that more people are struggling with stress, and a significant portion of this is linked to their jobs. It seems that many individuals are working excessively hard, which is negatively impacting their well-being.

Experts suggest that employees are under too much pressure these days. In various roles, such as in sales or manufacturing, companies often set unrealistic targets for their staff. As a result, people are attempting the impossible, which can lead to illness.

In many countries, a growing number of people are working longer hours. Some employees are compelled to do so to manage their workload, while others believe that staying late will impress their superiors and increase their chances of promotion. This practice of spending extra time at work, even when not truly productive, is often referred to as 'presenteeism'.

Such excessive work often causes extreme tiredness, even complete exhaustion, with many individuals also suffering from insomnia. When workers finally get home, instead of relaxing or enjoying their free time, they find it difficult to switch off and are still preoccupied with work-related worries.

Many people used to be able to leave the tensions and anxieties of the workplace behind when they went on vacation. However, modern communication technologies, such as smartphones and email, have largely made this impossible. We now find it almost impossible to disconnect from our work.

Neither the body nor the mind can sustain excessive workloads indefinitely. Employees eventually reach a point where they can no longer cope and need to take time off. Some may experience burn-out, a state of emotional, physical, and mental exhaustion, while others may develop mental health issues. Furthermore, a study conducted by several American universities has indicated that stress can weaken the immune system.

The link between work-related stress and illness is supported by findings from the British Health and Safety Executive. Their data suggests that 60 percent of work absences are attributable to stress. It is vital that we all take stress seriously and re-evaluate the ethics of modern working conditions. While hard work is important, we must recognize that even productivity is less important than our health and overall quality of life. Companies need to prioritize employee wellness and foster a more supportive work environment to counteract the detrimental effects of chronic stress.
mock_data.passageC1:
Mounting evidence suggests that workplace stress is reaching epidemic proportions, with a discernible upswing in the number of individuals succumbing to its debilitating effects. A significant portion of this stress, it would seem, stems directly from the pressures inherent in contemporary employment. The relentless pursuit of productivity, coupled with increasingly demanding workloads, is demonstrably taking a considerable toll on the well-being of the workforce.

Experts increasingly attribute this phenomenon to the unremitting pressure placed upon employees across various sectors. In fields such as sales and production, for instance, the imposition of patently unrealistic targets is commonplace. Consequently, individuals find themselves endeavouring to achieve the impossible, thereby jeopardizing their health in the process. The expectation to consistently exceed expectations, while perhaps beneficial to the bottom line, can have devastating consequences for individual employees.

Furthermore, the trend towards extended working hours is becoming increasingly pervasive across numerous nations. Whether driven by the necessity to manage an overwhelming workload or by the perceived need to impress superiors through conspicuous presenteeism, the result is the same: an erosion of work-life balance. This culture of prolonged exposure to the workplace can lead to a host of negative outcomes, both for the individual and, ultimately, for the organisation.

The consequences of such overwork often manifest as profound fatigue and even complete exhaustion, frequently accompanied by debilitating insomnia. Upon returning home, individuals find themselves unable to disentangle themselves from work-related anxieties, their minds remaining preoccupied with unresolved issues and impending deadlines. The mental and emotional residue of the workday lingers, preventing genuine rest and recuperation.

The traditional respite afforded by holidays has, unfortunately, been rendered largely obsolete by the pervasive influence of modern communication technologies. Mobile phones and email have effectively blurred the boundaries between work and leisure, making it exceedingly difficult to completely disconnect from professional obligations. The expectation of constant availability serves only to exacerbate the underlying stress.

Neither the human body nor the mind is capable of enduring such sustained pressure indefinitely. Eventually, individuals reach a breaking point, necessitating periods of absence from work. Some may experience full-blown burnout, while others may develop mental health issues. Moreover, research from American universities has indicated that chronic stress can significantly compromise the immune system, rendering individuals more susceptible to illness.

The correlation between workplace stress and illness is further substantiated by data from the British Health and Safety Executive, which suggests that a substantial proportion of work absences – as much as 60% – are attributable to stress-related conditions. It is therefore imperative that we address stress with the seriousness it warrants and critically re-evaluate the prevailing ethos of modern working conditions. While diligence and dedication are undoubtedly valuable assets, it is crucial to recognise that even enhanced productivity must never supersede the paramount importance of individual health and well-being.

mock_data.translation:
Statistika shuni ko'rsatadiki, ko'pchiligimiz stressdan aziyat chekmoqdamiz va buning asosiy sababi bizning ishimizdir. Ko'rinishidan, ko'pchiligimiz juda qattiq ishlayapmiz va bu sog'ligimizga zarar yetkazmoqda.

Mutaxassislar aytishlaricha, hozirgi kunda ko'plab xodimlarga haddan tashqari bosim qo'yilmoqda. Ko'plab ishlarda, masalan, savdo yoki ishlab chiqarish bo'limlarida, ishchi kuchi uchun haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan maqsadlar qo'yiladi. Odamlar aslida imkonsiz narsani qilishga harakat qilishmoqda va buni qilish orqali o'zlarini kasal qilishmoqda.

Ko'pgina mamlakatlarda tobora ko'proq odamlar uzoqroq soatlar ishlashmoqda. Ba'zi ishchilar ish yukini engish uchun buni qilishlari kerak, boshqalari esa kechgacha qolish boshliqni shunchalik ta'sirlantiradiki, u ularni lavozimga ko'tarishini o'ylashadi. Ish joyida bu uzoq vaqt davomida bo'lish prezentizm deb nomlanadi.

Bunday ortiqcha ish ko'pincha haddan tashqari charchoqqa yoki hatto to'liq toliqishga olib keladi, ko'plab odamlar uyqusizlikdan ham aziyat chekishadi. Ishchilar uyga kelganlarida, dam olish yoki dam olish mashg'ulotidan bahramand bo'lish o'rniga, ular shunchaki o'chirib qo'ya olmaydilar. Ularning fikrlari hali ham ish tashvishlari bilan to'lib-toshgan.

Ko'pchilik odamlar ta'tilga chiqishganda ish joyining tarangligi va tashvishini ortda qoldirishlari mumkin edi. Afsuski, mobil telefonlar va elektron pochta kabi zamonaviy aloqa tizimlari buni o'tmishning bir qismi qildi. Biz ishimizni ortda qoldirishni deyarli imkonsiz deb bilamiz.

Na tana, na ong haddan tashqari ko'p ish qilishni cheksiz davom ettira olmaydi. Ishchilar ular bardosh bera olmaydigan nuqtaga yetib borishadi va vaqt ajratishlari kerak. Ba'zilari kuyib ketish holatini boshdan kechirishi mumkin va ba'zilari ruhiy jihatdan kasal bo'lishi mumkin. Shu bilan birga, ba'zi Amerika universitetlari tomonidan o'tkazilgan tadqiqot shuni ko'rsatdiki, stress immunitet tizimini zaiflashtirishi mumkin.

Ishdagi stress kasallikka olib kelishi haqiqati Britaniya Sog'liqni Saqlash va Xavfsizlik Ijroiya Qo'mitasi tomonidan topilmalar bilan qo'llab-quvvatlanadi. Bular shuni ko'rsatadiki, ishdan ketishning 60 foizi stress natijasida yuzaga keladi. Biz hammamiz uchun stressni jiddiy qabul qilish va zamonaviy ish sharoitlarining etikasini qayta ko'rib chiqish vaqti keldi. Qattiq ishlash muhim, ammo hamma produktivlik ham bizning sog'ligimizdan kamroq muhimligini tushunishi kerak.

mock_data.translationB1:
Bugungi kunda ko'pchilik odamlar stressni his qilmoqdalar. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, bu stressning ko'p qismi ularning ishlaridan kelib chiqadi. Ko'rinishicha, ko'pchilik juda ko'p ishlamoqda va bu ularning sog'lig'i uchun yomon.

Mutaxassislarning aytishicha, ishchilarga juda ko'p bosim o'tkazilmoqda. Misol uchun, ba'zi ishlarda, masalan, sotuvda, ishchilar amalga oshirib bo'lmaydigan maqsadlarga erishishlari kerak. Odamlar juda qiyin bo'lgan ishlarni qilishga harakat qilmoqdalar va bu ularni kasal qiladi.

Ko'pgina mamlakatlarda odamlar uzoqroq soatlar ishlashmoqda. Ba'zi ishchilar o'z ishlarini tugatish uchun buni qilishlari kerak. Boshqalar esa agar ular kech qolsalar, boshliqlariga ta'sir qilishadi va ular yaxshiroq ish berishadi deb o'ylashadi. Bu 'presenteeism' deb ataladi - ishda uzoq vaqt bo'lish.

Haddan tashqari ishlash odamlarni juda charchatishi mumkin. Ba'zi odamlar yaxshi uxlolmaydilar (uyqusizlik). Ular uyga ketganlarida, dam ololmaydilar. Ular doimo ish muammolari haqida o'ylashadi.

Ilgari odamlar ta'tilga chiqqanlarida ish haqida unutishlari mumkin edi. Ammo endi, mobil telefonlar va elektron pochta orqali, ishni orqada qoldirish qiyin. Bu haqda o'ylashni to'xtatish qiyin.

Bizning tanalarimiz va ongimiz abadiy juda ko'p ishlay olmaydi. Odamlar bardosh bera olmaydigan nuqtaga etadilar. Ular ishdan dam olishlari kerak. Ba'zi odamlar charchoqni his qilishadi, ba'zilari esa ruhiy kasal bo'lib qolishadi. Tadqiqot shuni ko'rsatdiki, stress bizning tanalarimizni zaiflashtirishi va kasal bo'lish ehtimolini oshirishi mumkin.

Britaniyaning Sog'liqni saqlash va xavfsizlik bo'yicha ijroiya organi ma'lumotlariga ko'ra, ishdan yo'q bo'lgan odamlarning 60 foizi stress tufayli yo'q. Biz stressga jiddiy qarashimiz va qanday ishlashimiz haqida o'ylashimiz kerak. Ko'p ishlash muhim, lekin bizning sog'lig'imiz unumlilikdan ko'ra muhimroq.
mock_data.translationB2:
Statistikalar tobora ko'proq odamlar stress bilan kurashayotganini ko'rsatmoqda va buning katta qismi ularning ishi bilan bog'liq. Ko'rinishicha, ko'pchilik haddan tashqari ko'p ishlamoqda, bu esa ularning farovonligiga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatmoqda.

Mutaxassislarning fikricha, hozirgi kunda xodimlar haddan tashqari bosim ostida. Sotuv yoki ishlab chiqarish kabi turli sohalarda kompaniyalar ko'pincha xodimlar uchun amalga oshirib bo'lmaydigan maqsadlar qo'yishadi. Natijada, odamlar imkonsiz narsaga urinishmoqda, bu esa kasallikka olib kelishi mumkin.

Ko'pgina mamlakatlarda tobora ko'proq odamlar uzoqroq ishlashmoqda. Ba'zi xodimlar ish yukini boshqarish uchun shunday qilishga majbur bo'lishsa, boshqalari kechgacha qolish rahbarlariga taassurot qoldiradi va lavozimda ko'tarilish imkoniyatini oshiradi deb hisoblashadi. Ishda unumli bo'lmasa ham, qo'shimcha vaqt o'tkazish amaliyoti ko'pincha "presenteeizm" deb ataladi.

Bunday haddan tashqari ish ko'pincha juda charchoqqa, hatto butunlay holdan toyishga olib keladi, ko'plab odamlar uyqusizlikdan ham aziyat chekishadi. Ishchilar nihoyat uyga kelgach, dam olish yoki bo'sh vaqtlaridan zavqlanish o'rniga, o'zlarini chalg'itishni qiyin deb bilishadi va hali ham ish bilan bog'liq tashvishlar bilan band bo'lishadi.

Ko'pchilik odamlar ta'tilga chiqqanlarida ish joyidagi taranglik va xavotirlarni ortda qoldira olishardi. Biroq, zamonaviy aloqa texnologiyalari, masalan, smartfonlar va elektron pochta, buni asosan imkonsiz qilib qo'ydi. Hozir biz ishdan uzilishni deyarli imkonsiz deb bilamiz.

Na tana, na aql haddan tashqari ish yukini cheksiz ko'tara olmaydi. Xodimlar oxir-oqibat bardosh bera olmaydigan nuqtaga yetishadi va dam olishga muhtoj bo'lishadi. Ba'zilar charchoqdan yonib ketishlari mumkin, bu hissiy, jismoniy va ruhiy charchoq holati, boshqalarda esa ruhiy salomatlik bilan bog'liq muammolar paydo bo'lishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, bir nechta Amerika universitetlari tomonidan o'tkazilgan tadqiqot shuni ko'rsatdiki, stress immunitet tizimini zaiflashtirishi mumkin.

Ish bilan bog'liq stress va kasallik o'rtasidagi bog'liqlik Britaniya Sog'liqni saqlash va xavfsizlik boshqarmasi tomonidan olib borilgan topilmalar bilan tasdiqlangan. Ularning ma'lumotlariga ko'ra, ishda bo'lmaslikning 60 foizi stress bilan bog'liq. Barchamiz stressga jiddiy e'tibor qaratishimiz va zamonaviy ish sharoitlarining axloqini qayta baholashimiz juda muhim. Qattiq mehnat muhim bo'lsa-da, hatto unumdorlik ham sog'lig'imiz va hayotimizning umumiy sifatidan kam ahamiyatga ega ekanligini tan olishimiz kerak. Kompaniyalar xodimlar salomatligini ustuvor vazifa sifatida belgilashi va surunkali stressning zararli oqibatlariga qarshi kurashish uchun yanada qo'llab-quvvatlovchi ish muhitini yaratishi kerak.
mock_data.translationC1:
So‘nggi dalillar shuni ko‘rsatadiki, ish joyidagi stress epidemik darajaga yetmoqda, uning zaiflashtiruvchi ta’siriga berilayotgan odamlar soni sezilarli darajada ortib bormoqda. Ko‘rinishidan, bu stressning katta qismi bevosita zamonaviy ish bilan ta’minlashdagi bosimdan kelib chiqadi. Ish unumdorligini tinimsiz oshirishga intilish, ortib borayotgan ish hajmi bilan birgalikda ishchi kuchining farovonligiga sezilarli ta’sir ko‘rsatmoqda.

Mutaxassislar tobora ortib borayotgan bu hodisani turli sohalarda ishlaydigan xodimlarga doimiy bosim o‘tkazilayotgani bilan izohlashmoqda. Masalan, sotuv va ishlab chiqarish kabi sohalarda oshkora real bo‘lmagan maqsadlar qo‘yilishi odatiy holga aylangan. Natijada, odamlar imkonsiz narsaga erishishga harakat qilishadi va shu bilan birga o‘z sog‘lig‘ini xavf ostiga qo‘yishadi. Doimiy ravishda kutilganidan yuqori natijalarga erishish, ehtimol, foydaga foyda keltirishi mumkin, ammo bu alohida xodimlar uchun halokatli oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, ko‘plab davlatlarda ish vaqtini uzaytirish tendentsiyasi tobora keng tarqalmoqda. Haddan tashqari ish hajmini boshqarish zarurati yoki ko‘zga tashlanadigan hozirlik orqali rahbarlarga taassurot qoldirish zarurati tufayli bo‘ladimi, natija bir xil: ish va hayot muvozanatining buzilishi. Ish joyiga uzoq vaqt ta’sir qilish madaniyati ham shaxs, ham tashkilot uchun salbiy oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

Bunday haddan tashqari ishlashning oqibatlari ko‘pincha kuchli charchoq va hatto to‘liq holdan toyish, ko‘pincha esa uyqusizlik bilan birga namoyon bo‘ladi. Uyga qaytgach, odamlar o‘zlarini ish bilan bog‘liq tashvishlardan qutula olmaydilar, ularning ongida hal qilinmagan muammolar va yaqinlashib kelayotgan muddatlar band bo‘lib qoladi. Ish kunining ruhiy va hissiy qoldiqlari uzoq vaqt saqlanib qolib, haqiqiy dam olish va tiklanishga to‘sqinlik qiladi.

Afsuski, ta’tillar tomonidan taqdim etiladigan an’anaviy dam olish zamonaviy aloqa texnologiyalarining keng ta’siri tufayli deyarli yo‘qqa chiqarildi. Mobil telefonlar va elektron pochta ish va dam olish o‘rtasidagi chegaralarni xiralashtirdi va professional majburiyatlardan butunlay uzilib qolishni juda qiyinlashtirdi. Doimiy ravishda mavjud bo‘lish umidi shunchaki asosiy stressni kuchaytiradi.

Na inson tanasi, na aqli bunday doimiy bosimga cheksiz bardosh bera olmaydi. Oxir-oqibat, odamlar sinish nuqtasiga yetib boradilar va bu ishdan uzoqda bo‘lish davrini talab qiladi. Ba’zilar to‘liq yonib ketishni boshdan kechirishi mumkin, boshqalarda esa ruhiy salomatlik bilan bog‘liq muammolar paydo bo‘lishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, Amerika universitetlarining tadqiqotlari shuni ko‘rsatdiki, surunkali stress immunitet tizimiga jiddiy zarar yetkazishi va odamlarni kasalliklarga ko‘proq moyil qilishi mumkin.

Ish joyidagi stress va kasallik o‘rtasidagi bog‘liqlik Buyuk Britaniya Sog‘liqni saqlash va Xavfsizlik Ijroiya organining ma’lumotlari bilan ham tasdiqlanadi, bu ma’lumotlarga ko‘ra, ishdan qolishning katta qismi – 60 foizgacha – stress bilan bog‘liq holatlarga bog‘liq. Shuning uchun biz stressga unga loyiq bo‘lgan jiddiylik bilan yondashishimiz va zamonaviy ish sharoitlarining hukmron etosini tanqidiy baholashimiz kerak. Mehnatsevarlik va fidoyilik, shubhasiz, qimmatli fazilatlar bo‘lsa-da, hatto oshirilgan unumdorlik ham hech qachon shaxsning sog‘lig‘i va farovonligining muhim ahamiyatidan ustun bo‘lmasligi kerakligini tan olish muhimdir.
